result.rationale: Horizon New Energy is expressly a CIP-managed Canadian portfolio company, while Horizon presents Aira Solar as a project. Alberta records show CI V-named Horizon/Aira entities and a 2025 internal amalgamation into CI V Aira Holdco Ltd. Current Horizon and AESO sources show active, construction-ready development, not a separate operating or exited manager-level company. Count Horizon once and retain Aira only as asset history.
